HOW_TO_PLAY_CONTENT.INTRO: Little Fuck is a card game for 2 or more players. Everyone starts with lives and loses lives when they miss their guesses. The last player still alive wins.
HOW_TO_PLAY_CONTENT.OBJECTIVE: Survive to the end. In each match, guess exactly how many rounds you will win. Miss your guess and you lose lives equal to the size of the miss: guessed 5 but won 2? You lose 3 lives.
HOW_TO_PLAY_CONTENT.CARDS: There are 52 numbered cards. Cards 1 to 12 are regular cards (four of each) and cards 13 to 16 are the trumps, the strongest cards in the game. The higher the number, the stronger the card.
HOW_TO_PLAY_CONTENT.MATCHES: In the first match each player gets 1 card; in the second, 2; and so on. When the deck is not big enough for everyone, it goes back to 1 card per player.
HOW_TO_PLAY_CONTENT.GUESS: Look at your cards and say how many rounds you think you will win. The last player to guess has one restriction: their guess cannot make the sum of all guesses equal the number of cards in the match.
HOW_TO_PLAY_CONTENT.ROUNDS: In each round, everyone plays one card and the highest card wins the round. If the highest cards tie, nobody scores that round. The winner of a round leads the next one.
HOW_TO_PLAY_CONTENT.SPECIAL: When each player has only 1 card, the match is special: you cannot see your own card, but you can see everyone else's cards. Guess based on your opponents' cards!
